lesson: In merge_records, duplicate contacts must be keyed on the lowercased email and calendar day of the update, keeping the record with the latest updated timestamp when collisions occur.
why: Matching on the raw (email, updated) pair causes duplicate entries when emails have different casing or multiple syncs happen on the same day.
quote: merge_records keys on (email lowercased, same calendar day) and resolves collisions by keeping the record with the latest updated timestamp.

lesson: In the record merge rule, replace the rejected keep-latest recency logic by resolving collisions in favor of the record with more non-empty fields, defaulting to the CRM-side record on ties.
why: The nightly sync job was sending stripped-down records whose newer timestamps caused keep-latest to overwrite richer existing names and phone numbers.
quote: on collision the most-filled record wins; on a filled-count tie the primary/CRM-side record is kept.
